name: Rider
meaning: News arrives quickly. An important message is on its way. Movement and momentum define the moment.
love: A suitor or admirer is drawing near. Romantic news is coming soon.
work: A job proposal or offer appears. Quick action is needed.
health: High energy. A good time to start a treatment.

name: Clover
meaning: Small fortunes and everyday blessings. Luck that is brief but genuine. Enjoy the simple moments.
love: Small gestures of affection bring happiness. A light, easygoing romance.
work: A small but useful opportunity comes up. Don't underestimate it.
health: Recovery goes well. Spirit and energy return.

name: Ship
meaning: Journeys, relocations and business from afar. The horizon widens. Changes coming from far away.
love: A long distance relationship or one with a foreigner. A temporary separation.
work: International business or a work trip. Promising trade.
health: A change of scenery may help. Consider alternative treatments.

name: House
meaning: Stability, protection and roots. Home life is in focus. Property and belonging.
love: A steady union and shared life. A wish to start a family or move in together.
work: Your own business or working from home. A stable workplace.
health: Care at home. Comfort and recovery among family.

name: Tree
meaning: Slow, solid growth. Health and vitality. Connection with ancestors and origins. Patience.
love: A lasting relationship with deep roots. Love that matures over time.
work: A solid career that grows step by step. Long term investments.
health: Overall health is in focus. Treat your body with care and patience.

name: Clouds
meaning: A hazy, confusing situation. A temporary lack of clarity. The storm will pass, so wait.
love: Misunderstandings and insecurity in the relationship. Communication needs to improve.
work: Uncertainty at work. Put off big decisions until the view clears.
health: An unclear diagnosis or a period of low energy. Get a second opinion.

name: Snake
meaning: A clever but manipulative person is nearby. Intense desire. Sharp intuition.
love: Strong attraction, but possible betrayal. Jealousy and possessiveness appear.
work: An envious colleague or unfair competition. Watch your back.
health: Built up tension that needs release. Look after your nervous system.

name: Coffin
meaning: The close of a cycle. Deep transformation. What ends makes room for the new.
love: The end of a relationship or of a phase in love. Let go to begin again.
work: The end of a job or project. A career change is coming.
health: A healing period: something has to die for the body to renew itself.

name: Bouquet
meaning: Gifts, compliments and recognition arrive. Genuine happiness. Moments of joy and gratitude.
love: Romance blossoms. Courtship, gifts and enchanting moments.
work: Public recognition of your work. A reward or bonus is on its way.
health: Health in full bloom. Inner and outer beauty stand out.

name: Scythe
meaning: A sharp, final decision. Reap what you have sown. Cut away what no longer serves you.
love: A drastic decision in love. A necessary break with the past.
work: Time to reap results or make a final career decision.
health: Intervention is needed. Cut habits that harm your health.

name: Whip
meaning: Recurring conflicts and heated arguments. Energy that needs direction. Patterns that repeat.
love: Fights and tension in the relationship. A negative cycle repeats.
work: A conflict ridden workplace. Intense, repetitive effort.
health: Inflammation or chronic pain. Avoid excessive stress.

name: Birds
meaning: Lots of talk and exchange of ideas. An elderly couple or established partners. Anxious thoughts.
love: A couple bound by communication. Constant dialogue, sometimes too much.
work: Meetings, negotiations and lots of dialogue. Communication is key.
health: Anxiety and nerves run high. Care for your mind and breathe.

name: Child
meaning: Fresh, innocent beginnings. Something new and small is born. Openness to learning.
love: A new love or the early phase of a romance. Naivety and purity of feeling.
work: A new job, a project just starting, or a return to studying.
health: A period of healing and rebirth. Treat your body gently.

name: Fox
meaning: Cunning and shrewdness are needed. Someone may be deceiving you, or you may be fooling yourself.
love: Be wary of appearances. Someone may not be who they claim to be.
work: You need to be strategic. Watch out for opportunistic colleagues.
health: Misleading symptoms. Seek an accurate diagnosis and question the obvious.

name: Bear
meaning: A figure of authority and protection. Raw but protective strength. Power and leadership are at play.
love: A strong, protective partner. Beware of possessive jealousy.
work: A boss or mentor stands out. Time to show leadership.
health: High physical strength and immunity. Watch your weight and blood pressure.

name: Star
meaning: Hope and inspiration light the way. Dreams that can come true. Divine guidance.
love: Ideal, romantic love. Soulmates and spiritual connections.
work: Success and recognition are on their way. Follow your guiding star.
health: A favorable time for holistic and spiritual healing.

name: Stork
meaning: A big change is coming. A new life cycle is born. A positive, long awaited transformation.
love: A fresh start in love. A possible pregnancy or the arrival of a baby.
work: A job change or promotion. A new professional chapter begins.
health: Good health news. Pregnancy or physical renewal.

name: Dog
meaning: A faithful, loyal friend is present. Trust that doesn't disappoint. Unconditional support.
love: A relationship built on friendship and deep loyalty.
work: A trusted colleague or partner. Harmonious teamwork.
health: Emotional support from friends helps healing.

name: Tower
meaning: Solitude, chosen or imposed. Large institutions, laws and structures. Temporary isolation.
love: Loneliness in love. Emotional barriers make intimacy hard.
work: A large company, government, or a solitary career. A ceiling on growth.
health: Isolation that affects mental health. Seek connection.

name: Garden
meaning: An active social life and public gatherings. Community and events. Your public image is at stake.
love: Romance starts at social events. A relationship in the public eye.
work: Networking and professional visibility. Work with the public.
health: Outdoor and group activities benefit your health.

name: Mountain
meaning: A big obstacle on the path. Overcoming it takes perseverance. The challenge builds character.
love: Serious difficulties in the relationship. Resistance from others.
work: A temporary career block. Perseverance will pay off.
health: A serious illness that takes determination to overcome.

name: Crossroads
meaning: Paths cross and a choice is unavoidable. Two directions, only one can be taken. Decide.
love: A choice between two suitors or two paths in love.
work: An important career decision. Two professional paths open up.
health: A decision about treatment. Two options: trust your intuition.

name: Mice
meaning: Something is slowly being drained. Accumulated losses and wear. Protect what has value.
love: Wear and tear in the relationship. Small lies erode trust.
work: Financial losses or stolen ideas. Protect your work.
health: Energy is slipping away. Look after your diet and sleep.

name: Heart
meaning: Love in all its depth. Intense, true feelings. The heart speaks loudest.
love: Genuine, passionate love. A declaration of feelings. A partnership of the heart.
work: Work at what you love. Passion for what you do brings success.
health: Heart health is in focus. Care for your emotions to care for your body.

name: Ring
meaning: Formal commitment and a lasting alliance. Signed contracts. A sealed union.
love: Engagement, marriage or a serious commitment. Love becomes official.
work: An important contract is signed. A long term professional partnership.
health: Commitment to a health routine. A long term treatment.

name: Book
meaning: Hidden knowledge and kept secrets. Study and research are needed. A revelation to come.
love: Secrets in the relationship. Something hasn't been revealed yet. Be patient.
work: Study and training are essential now. Privileged information.
health: The diagnosis is still incomplete. Research and learn about your condition.

name: Letter
meaning: An important message, letter or document arrives. Written communication stands out.
love: A love message or romantic news. A declaration in writing.
work: A contract, proposal or official answer is on its way.
health: Test results or a medical report arrive soon.

name: Man
meaning: A central male figure in the question. May represent the querent himself or an important man.
love: The man in the love situation. Traits of the partner.
work: A male colleague, boss or partner stands out.
health: Men's health is in focus. Pay attention to male health.

name: Woman
meaning: A central female figure in the question. May represent the querent herself or an important woman.
love: The woman in the love situation. Traits of the partner.
work: A female colleague, boss or partner stands out.
health: Women's health is in focus. Pay attention to female health.

name: Lilies
meaning: Peace and harmony arrive after effort. Maturity and the wisdom of experience. Purity of intention.
love: Mature, calm and harmonious love. Emotional stability.
work: A mature, respected career. Work with ethics and harmony.
health: A time of peace and quiet recovery. Stable health.

name: Sun
meaning: Great success and total clarity. Vital energy at its peak. Everything that was dark lights up.
love: Radiant, happy love. A golden period in the relationship.
work: Full success, recognition and prosperity. Shine!
health: Excellent health and abundant energy. A time of great vitality.

name: Moon
meaning: Public recognition and fame. Deep emotions and sharp intuition. The unconscious speaks.
love: Deep, emotional love. Intuition guides the heart. Intense romance.
work: Recognition in a creative career. Work with art or mystery.
health: Emotional health is in focus. Hormonal cycles and sleep deserve attention.

name: Key
meaning: The solution exists and is within reach. A door opens. Destiny is on your side. Access granted.
love: The key to the other's heart is found. The relationship is unlocked.
work: The solution to the work problem is clear. A door of opportunity opens.
health: You find what was blocking healing. An effective treatment is found.

name: Fish
meaning: A favorable cash flow. Abundance and material prosperity. Business flows well.
love: Abundant, generous love. A partner who provides material security.
work: Positive finances. Business and investments flow well.
health: Body fluids and circulation are in focus. Stay hydrated and mind your metabolism.

name: Anchor
meaning: Stability earned through effort. Perseverance that finally finds a safe harbor.
love: A stable, lasting relationship. Love that anchors and sustains.
work: A solid, secure position. A stable job for a long time.
health: Stable health after a hard period. Persistence heals.

name: Cross
meaning: An unavoidable burden that must be carried. Karma and destiny at work. A sacrifice that transforms.
love: Sacrifice for love. A relationship that demands total dedication.
work: Hard work and heavy responsibility. Calling versus obligation.
health: A chronic condition that calls for acceptance and adaptation.
